lines.en: I dart across the rocks.
I streak across the clearing.
My tail swings behind me.
I leap from stone to stone.
I run low and fast.
I turn a corner and vanish.
I slip under the brush.
I dash up a low wall and down.
My claw tips rake the dirt.
I keep up a steady trot.
I run a wide circle.
I dart out ahead of you.
I squeeze through the gap.
I crouch on a stone and look around.
My tail stands up.
I lift a paw to groom.
I sniff the air.
I stay still and listen.
My eyes dart about.
I wrap my tail over my nose
I poke my head out of a crevice.
My claws grip the stone.
I am waiting for a bug.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵抖了一下，有发光浆果味。
lines.en: My ears twitched; I smell glow berries.
I lick my paw slowly.
I hide behind the stone.
I cock my head at the distance.
I arch my back and scratch my cheek
I poke my head out from the stone.
I am eyeing the glow berries in your palm
If you move, I bolt.
I tip my head and look you over.
You are in my path.
I lift a paw and set it down.
I do not quite trust you.
I slip to the other side of the rock
It is better now that you crouch.
My eyes stay on you.
I lower my tail.
Your fingers smell of glow berries

lines.zh: 我在算跳到哪块石头上
lines.en: I am picking my next stone.
Speak more quietly.
I have not decided whether to leave.
I come a little closer.
I squeak and dart up the low wall
I squeak.
I cover the hurt spot.
I limp backward.
I squeeze into a crack and shiver
Blood mats my fur.
I tremble for a while.
I lick the wound slowly.
I have not got far.
I watch you warily.
Glow berries! I see them.
That smell is sweet.

lines.zh: 抓到我，喂几颗发光浆果就行。
lines.en: Catch me and feed me a few glow berries.
I reach out a paw.
I want that badly.
I hug it and gnaw.
Could you spare another?
I stuff the berry in my cheek.
I circle around you.
I chirp in a thin little voice.
I cannot forget that sweetness
I crouch at your feet and eat.
This beats bugs.
Touch me and I spring off.
I shoot up onto the stone.
My tail was nearly stepped on.
I squeak and run off.
The knock rolls me half over.

lines.zh: 我一溜烟窜过石头，尾巴甩着。
lines.en: I dash across the rocks, tail swinging.
Then I come back to look.
You nearly caught me.
I stop two blocks away.
I shake out my fur.

lines.zh: 另一只从石头后跑出来
lines.en: Another darts out from the rocks.
We chase each other in circles.
Our tails wind together.
It steals the berry from my mouth.
The rings on my tail are me.
It runs even faster than I.
It leans in and grooms me.
We squeeze into one burrow.
It chirps and I follow.
We both dart out of sight.
I snatch up the berry.
I push it into my cheek.
I run with it in my paws.
I dig a hole and bury it.
I scratch it up to check.
I carry it up onto the stone.
I bat it with a paw.
It slips from my paws.
I snatch it right back.
I hide it in a crevice.
I freeze.
My ears shoot up.
I glare that way.
A bug, and something else.
I hold still and look first.
My tail freezes stiff.
I am looking for an escape.
I back half a step onto the stone.
Something moves in the grass.
I am ready to bolt.
I keep my eyes on that shadow.
My claws cannot grip the stone
I am picking the safest landing.

lines.zh: 它靠近一步我就退一步
lines.en: It steps in; I step back.
I am working out where it is safest to jump.
The grass tips move.
I press close to the stone.
I can bolt at any moment.

lines.zh: 我听见了不太对的声音
lines.en: I hear something wrong.
I wait for it to lift a foot.
I snap hold of its foot.
I swipe with my claws.
I pounce and spring back.
I bite and run.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在它脸上划过
lines.en: My claws rake its face.
I dart past its back.
It turns a beat too late.

lines.zh: 我跳到它头顶的石头上
lines.en: I leap onto the stone above it.
I used my teeth that time.
I look back as I run.
I squeeze out of a crevice.
I dart onto the stone and stop.
My tail shows up first.
A shadow appears in the clearing.
First I sniff the ground.
My paws land lightly.

lines.zh: 我在这里找到落脚的地方
lines.en: I have found a foothold here.
I look up at the high ground.
I crouch, ready to run.
Wet dirt clings to me.
My fur is singed.
I fall off the stone.
Water makes me cough.
The blast knocks me over.
An arrow is stuck in my hind leg
Spell light leaves me numb.
Hunger keeps me from running.
I curl up in the lightning.
There is nothing to land on.
